title: Molecular Docking and Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Zn(II) Proline-Cysteine-Dithiocarbamate, Zn(II) Proline-Cysteine-Proline-Dithiocarbamate, and Zn(II) Arginine-Cysteine-Dithiocarbamate as Anticancer Agents against a DNA Target.
authors: Irfandi, Rizal; Raya, Indah; Fudholi, Ahmad; Ahmad, Ahyar; Muharram, Muharram; Luthfiana, Dewi; Ilham, Baso; Fauziah, Siti; Mazaya, Maulida; Putri, Suriati Eka; Pratiwi, Diana Eka; Ahmad, Fandi
journal: Asian Pacific journal of cancer prevention : APJCP
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接和MD模拟研究锌配合物与DNA的结合，但对象为小分子-DNA而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cancer treatment has long relied on chemotherapy agents such as cisplatin, but their side effects and the development of resistance have spurred the search for alternative drugs. OBJECTIVE: This study explores the potential of Zn(II)-based complexes, namely ZnProCysDTC, ZnProCysProDTC, and ZnArgCysDTC, as DNA-targeting anticancer agents. METHODS: Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations were employed to assess the binding stability and structural effects of these complexes on DNA. RESULTS: The results revealed that ZnArgCysDTC showed the most significant interaction with DNA, exhibiting high RMSD, binding energy, and hydrogen-bonding stability. ZnProCysProDTC and ZnProCysDTC also demonstrated strong binding, but with weaker stability than ZnArgCysDTC. The findings suggest that ZnArgCysDTC holds promise as an alternative to cisplatin, offering similar or superior DNA-binding potential with potentially fewer side effects. CONCLUSION: This study provides valuable insights into the design of Zn(II)-based compounds for anticancer therapy and underscores the need for further optimization. Future research should focus on enhancing the stability and therapeutic efficacy of these complexes to develop safer and more effective cancer treatments.
abstract_zh: 背景：癌症治疗长期以来依赖顺铂等化疗药物，但其副作用和耐药性的产生促使人们寻找替代药物。目的：本研究探讨Zn(II)基配合物，即ZnProCysDTC、ZnProCysProDTC和ZnArgCysDTC，作为靶向DNA的抗癌药物的潜力。方法：采用分子对接 (molecular docking) 和分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟来评估这些配合物与DNA的结合稳定性及结构影响。结果：结果显示，ZnArgCysDTC与DNA的相互作用最为显著，表现出高RMSD、结合能和氢键稳定性。ZnProCysProDTC和ZnProCysDTC也表现出较强的结合能力，但稳定性弱于ZnArgCysDTC。研究结果表明，ZnArgCysDTC有望作为顺铂的替代品，提供相似或更优的DNA结合潜力，且可能具有更少的副作用。结论：本研究为抗癌治疗中Zn(II)基化合物的设计提供了有价值的见解，并强调了进一步优化的必要性。未来研究应侧重于增强这些配合物的稳定性和治疗效果，以开发更安全、更有效的癌症治疗方法。
